item.title: Goal 987: Ronaldo passes Hamdallah to become Al Nassr's all-time top scorer in Asia
item.description:
🔥 From the penalty spot in the 13th minute against Al-Sadd, Cristiano Ronaldo scored his 17th Asian goal for Al Nassr, moving past Morocco's Abderrazak Hamdallah (16). It is the 987th goal of his career, with 13 to go.
#CR7 #Ronaldo #Hamdallah #Nassr #Asie
